title: replay_draws.py docstring names tests/replay_draws.tsv; the table it fills is tests/replay_cost_draws.tsv
claim: tools/audit/seat/replay_draws.py's module docstring says the harvested rows are what 'tests/replay_draws.tsv holds', but tests/replay.py:COST_DRAWS, the table the same module grades and shifts (replay.COST_DRAWS at lines 166/193/303), is tests/replay_cost_draws.tsv and no tests/replay_draws.tsv is tracked.
mechanism: The docstring names a file that never existed under that name; the module's own code (and its later docstring paragraph, line 25) use COST_DRAWS. Fails D5-criteria C1, C2.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb replay: replay COST_DRAWS repointed in memory at ROOT/tests/replay_draws.tsv (the docstring's name)

metric_definition: 1 when the path the replay_draws.py docstring names differs from tests/replay.py:COST_DRAWS as the imported module delivers it, else 0.
phenomenon_property: Every repository path, script name, usage-line option and stated item count a comment unit or docstring in the seat's cells names resolves at the ref and agrees with what the code it sits on delivers (D5-criteria C1, C2)
